scientific_choices.ASSUMPTION: Only after an image is routed to DeepSolo, greedily match its words one-to-one to already available light words by predicted box IoU and replace a fallback transcript only when the trained word-correctness probability and optional edit-distance rule qualify. Preserve fallback instances/geometry and the existing optional light complement. Compare the same finite policy grid on TRAIN crossfold plus validation with a validation non-regression guard. No extra neural models, TEST information or changes to the fixed image budget.
scientific_choices.HARDWARE_DEVIATION: CPU postprocessing over authentic cached predictions; no new neural inference or online latency measurement.
scientific_choices.PAPER_SPECIFIED: PARSeq and DeepSolo fallback motivation only; this replacement policy is an approximate extension.
scientific_choices.REPOSITORY_SPECIFIED: Already qualified real light/DeepSolo predictions, existing trained word-risk probabilities and exact native256 lexical/ignore protocol.
scientific_choices.UNRESOLVED: Conditional non-nested folds, finite validation, vocabulary side information, historical/repeated TEST exploration, upstream exposure and cross-dataset performance.
